environment: in-memory synthetic Store and mocked Obsidian; no original-app L4 or native integration

results.name: opening restores the newest qualifying ordinary canvas, excluding TOC and review
mount without opening does not restore navigation; existing empty canvas is reused and canvasless set silently initializes one without undo history
removing a document preserves hidden cards, membership, pending, schedules and logs
references share latest title/excerpt/note/media/style but keep local display state
nonformal detach and same-canvas detach preserve source positions
splitting title keeps only its anchored half shared and round-trips undo
splitting excerpt keeps only its anchored half shared and round-trips undo
splitting note keeps only its anchored half shared and round-trips undo
empty excerpt head stays independent while the original tail keeps the anchor
merge retains anchored OR draft entities and snapshots unanchored non-drafts
merge guards reject self and members, while a head can absorb another member
merging a selected reference materializes it without changing the other canvas
unmerge uses current retained member data and preserves head edits without an extra duplicate
unmerge restores collapsed children and labels without discarding later graph edits
removing a group head recovers its members rather than stranding their pending rows
automatic merge gate rejects each protected content or relationship
mixed occlusion selection clears the group atomically with synchronized dates and undo
local group occlusion survives materialization but stays independent of another reference
text range add/remove is one persisted undo action and never cuts a Unicode pair
plain cloze export unwraps nested bold once and preserves cN as a separate extension
editing an enrolled basic question into plain cloze keeps it due without inventing a review
recall keys use the evidenced rect/range formats and a reversible memory-only single peek
selected review copy content and masks are independent before enrollment
conflicting group versions remap archived members, nodes, pending and reversible presentation
conflict merge keeps each excerpt destination attached to its own canvas and node
newer visited pending cannot revive an older active row during conflict reconciliation
